text: PlayStation Store listings show GTA 6 unlocking at midnight local time on 19 November, region by region. New Zealand is first. Xbox has not shown its times yet.
Take-Two named the 19 November launch again in its quarterly results and kept its sales forecast. No new delay.
Rockstar set the launch plan: pre-orders from 25 June, digital preload from 12 November, and the boxed copy on sale from 12 November. The box holds a download code, not a disc.
